1.consolidated_definition: Libélula de hasta 4 cm de longitud, de cuerpo fino y alargado, patas y abdomen corto y coloración diversa. (Coenagrionidae, Enallagma cyathigerum).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Dragonfly of up to 4 cm in length, with a slender and elongated body, short legs and abdomen, and diverse coloration. (Coenagrionidae, Enallagma cyathigerum).
